title: feat(spec): every step a flow drawing shows can be translated, under flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYV2nRmpjdz5BmCf9psuMXA)_

Part of #35979 (Asked item 2 only, as ruled in comment 7076440876; Asked item 1 is PR #36335, merged)

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTrJZvNaijgX3NxBMc

Clause-②: yes (widening: a new translation key `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label`; the new exports `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` and `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` from `@objectstack/spec/automation`; and `@object-ui/i18n`'s exported `FlowLabelTranslations` type gains the member `screenTitle`, and its `stepLabel` parameter accepts a `config`)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36401

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用包现在可以给流程里每个步骤（开始、判断、通知、结束等）写各语言名称；手册里的流程图和 Studio 流程画布都按读者语言显示这些步骤名，中文下不再夹英文。已发布语言的应用在检查里会多出这些步骤的缺译提示。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 销售手册的审批流程图在中文下仍显示英文的判断和通知步骤，维护者在卡上选了「补上翻译位，可以翻译」。
- 出错会怎样：只影响显示和缺译提示，不改流程运行和任何数据；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Both halves are on this branch: the key, its validation and its coverage demand, and the readers that draw it (on `main` since PR #36335 merged the shared flow-label resolution into `@object-ui/i18n`).

- **The key** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`). `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label`, a strict entry with one plain-text leaf, `label`, overlaying the node's own `FlowNode.label`. It addresses every node but a `screen` (whose `screens.NODE_ID.title` covers `config.title ?? node.label`) and an `approval` (`approvals.NODE_ID.label`), so one string keeps one key. `nodes` was an unknown-key alias onto `screens`; it is now the real group (`node` aliases onto it). The `## nodes` docblock section states the rule; the convention list gains the row.
- **Start and end nodes (ruling item 3).** Keyed like any other step; the viewer supplies no words of its own. Measured on `examples/app-showcase` at c448c615: of the start/end labels, 25 are `End` and 11 `Start`, but the rest name an outcome or a trigger (`Approved` x5, `Rejected` x5, `Signed Off`, `Declined`, `On Task Created` x3, `Daily at 06:00`, ...), which a generic word would erase.
- **Validation** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`). A `nodes` key over an unknown node is `translation-target-unknown` with the nearest node offered; over a `screen` it is pointed at `screens.NODE_ID.title`, over an `approval` at `approvals.NODE_ID.label`. The reverse slips now point at the new key: a `screens` or `approvals` key over any other node says `its label is keyed nodes.NODE_ID.label` (two existing messages gain that clause instead of "so nothing resolves").
- **The demand** (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `i18n/missing-flow`). Every top-level node the docs embed draws at its default `detail: business` altitude, minus screens and approvals, which were already demanded; and, since the embed's branch list names the step each branch of a drawn decision leads to, a folded technical step a branch names (seat reading L2 S1; live case: app-todo's `check_recurring` branching to the `compute_next_due_date` script). `decisionBranchTechnicalTargets` mirrors which out-edges the viewer lists (`flow-branches.ts` `decisionBranches`). Region-nested nodes are accepted by validation but not demanded: the embed does not draw them. `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` only updates the bucket's description.
- **The readers** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts`). The shared `stepLabel` now reads each step's one key by node type: `approvals.NODE_ID.label` for an approval, `screens.NODE_ID.title` for a screen with no `config.title`, `nodes.NODE_ID.label` for any other node. The docs viewer's `type: flow` embed (`metadata-viewer.tsx`, new `flowStepName`) names each drawn step and each decision-branch target by it; the Studio canvas (`FlowCanvas`, and `flow-region-view`'s `RegionNode` for nested region nodes) and the inspector heading read the same `stepLabel` unchanged, so a nested node's key, which validation accepts, has a reader.
- **A titled screen (seat reading S3).** A screen with its own `config.title` shows that heading at run time, translated under `screens.NODE_ID.title`; its canvas label has no key. The docs embed names such a screen by its heading (translated where the bundle carries it), unless the heading holds a `{{ }}` hole a drawing cannot fill, in which case it keeps the authored label. `FlowLabelTranslations` gains `screenTitle` for this read. The Studio canvas keeps a titled screen's authored label, since that is the label the designer edits.
- **One table for business altitude** (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts`). The viewer's private `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` set becomes `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` + `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` in `@objectstack/spec/automation`; the viewer folds steps by it and the walk demands by it, so they agree on which steps a reader sees.
- **Examples.** `app-crm`'s lead-conversion wizard gets its three drawn steps in zh-CN (its baseline stays 0). The ratchet in `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` is raised for the new population, as the PR that first walked the validation-message family did: `app-showcase` 317 -> 425 (+108, one of them the folded `showcase_inquiry_purge.purge` a branch names), `app-todo` 106 -> 130 (+24, two of them `todo_task_completion.compute_next_due_date` in its two translated locales); the other 12 configs are unchanged (the ten bundle packages stay 0, `check:i18n` in sync).
- **Ledger and pins.** `liveness/translation.json` gains `flows.nodes` (+ `label`), `live`, citing `flowLabelTranslations`, `flowStepName`, `FlowCanvas` and `RegionNode`. `flows-translation-face.test.ts`: the `node.label` row now lists `nodes.NODE.label` beside `approvals.NODE.label`.
- **Generated.** `api-surface/automation.json`, `export-origins/automation.json`, `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, the strictness-ledger counts and the liveness state counts, regenerated by `check:generated --fix`.

## Read first (by risk)

1. `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, the new loop at the end of `walkScreenFlows`: what is demanded (top level, not technical, not screen/approval).
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` `stepLabel` and `metadata-viewer.tsx` `flowStepName`: which key each node type reads, and the titled-screen rule.
3. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, the `nodes` entry and the `nodes` / `steps` alias changes.
4. `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, the `nodes` block and the two redirect clauses.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts`; expect 6 passed, including HotCRM's `opportunity_approval` shape asking for its start, decision, notify, loop and end labels and nothing for its approvals, screen or record write.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins</summary>

- `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts` (new family file, like the screen / approval / refusal family files beside it): the walker harvests exactly the drawn steps with no other key, seeded with the authored label; a folded step only where a drawn decision's listed branch names it, once (a conditions-free decision lists every out-edge; a `conditions` decision its default and its claimed labels; an unclaimed label and a non-decision source name nothing); nothing for any other `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` step or an id-less node; every harvested key parses and is kept by `TranslationDataSchema`; the coverage gate lists them in the flow bucket and goes quiet once translated.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`: a new top-level describe (clean run over start / decision / loop / nested notify / end beside the other groups; `nodes` over an approval and over a screen redirected; unknown node with suggestion), the two changed redirect messages, and the one-line-verdict arm list gains the four new arms.
- The screen, approval and liveness-gate family files in `packages/cli/test/` pin exact key lists of their own family; they now read every key but the `nodes` family (one predicate per file, pointing at the new file).
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe: start / decision / notify / end by `nodes`, an untitled screen by `screens` title, a titled screen by its translated heading and a holed heading by its label, a decision-branch target by `nodes`, and the business view folding exactly `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.test.tsx`: `stepLabel` reads each group by node type (and never another type's group under the same id); the canvas draws a decision's and a nested notify's translation; the inspector heading titles a decision by its `nodes` key with the authored label beside it.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs at cafc3fdf (the spec half) unless noted</summary>

- `@objectstack/lint` whole suite (before the L2 S1 widening): `Test Files 225 passed (225)`, `Tests 9431 passed (9431)` (at eabf0e62; lint unchanged since).
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project, the 60 i18n / translation / lint test files: 18 failures at eabf0e62, all exact key lists in the three family files above; after the predicate, those 4 files `Tests 52 passed (52)`.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `flows-translation-face.test.ts` + `translation.test.ts`, `Tests 238 passed (238)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 5 stale before regeneration, all 5 green after `--fix`.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs`: before the baseline edit `app-crm 0 -> 3`, `app-showcase 317 -> 424`, `app-todo 106 -> 128`; after: `OK (14 config(s), 552 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. `pnpm check:i18n`: all ten bundle packages in sync. `pnpm check:i18n-walk-parity`: 17 declared, 15 walked, 2 exempted.
- Derived gate sweep at cafc3fdf (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 127 commands): 126 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 for want of a full build; left to CI). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 127 accounted for.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs at bc0171d8 (the reader half, after merging main at dda5e74f)</summary>

- ui, from `ui/`: `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` + `flowNodeLabels.sites-13200.test.ts`, 64 tests passed; `metadata-viewer.test.tsx` at its final edit, `Tests 22 passed (22)` (two runs before it failed on the test's own isolation: a shared i18n instance and a locale-specific string, both fixed in the test).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: all exit 0 (after building app-shell's dependency closure, 68 of 68 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: the 2 artifacts the merge deferred plus the liveness counts regenerated, all 3 re-checked green.
- Derived gates for the files changed since the first sweep (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 96 commands): 96 exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 96 accounted for, 0 NOT MEASURED (derived from recorded exit codes).
- `overlap-check.mjs`: merges cleanly with `origin/main` at 316f7571.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs at 04d28e04 (the L1 / L2 rework)</summary>

- `@objectstack/lint` whole suite: `Test Files 225 passed (225)`, `Tests 9444 passed (9444)`.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project, the 4 flow family files: `Tests 53 passed (53)` (the new folded-branch-target pin included).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs`: `app-showcase 424 -> 425`, `app-todo 128 -> 130` before `--update`; the new keys are `flows.showcase_inquiry_purge.nodes.purge.label` and `flows.todo_task_completion.nodes.compute_next_due_date.label`. `check:generated` green after rebuilding spec.
- Derived gates for the files changed since bc0171d8 (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 105 commands): 105 exit 0; `--ran`: 105 accounted for, 0 NOT MEASURED.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main` and the open PRs sharing files (#36517, #36527).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `flows.FLOW.label` is still demanded only for a flow with a screen or an approval node, although item 1's viewer draws the label of every embedded flow. Not widened here, by the seat's word: filed as #36400.
- HotCRM's own translations (`opportunity_approval`: 9 of 11 drawn steps) are a follow-up in that repository now that the key has a reader: #36402.
- The i18n skill's text for the new key is owed: #36401.
- A titled screen whose heading holds a `{{ }}` hole is drawn in the docs embed by its authored label, which has no key, so it stays in the authored language: carded as #36530 with the L2's N2. Every other step the embed names has a key and a reader.
